pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into active retracements; add volume only when existing position reaches +$10.00 unrealized profit and breaks even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce ATR-based volatility buffer ensuring stop-losses are never placed tighter than 1.5x the 5-minute ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$15.00 and lock remaining runner with a structural trailing stop to target +$30.00.
